constraints: Production code unchanged. No running user Blent instance, live ADB endpoint, camera, audio service or display was changed. All processes/devices created for observations were isolated fixtures and retired; no install or push. One paused-clock probe stalled because its fixture kept the executor ready while waiting for a timer; its exact owned PID was terminated and its driver corrected to await event notifications, with final graceful stop/join recorded.

transport_answer.implemented: Linux ADB and feature-enabled direct USB; GUI dependency enables accessory-transport. Both camera paths feed the same decoder/output/brightness implementation.
transport_answer.ADB_gain: Authorized ADB invitations can start media without each direct-USB offer’s extra local Start; ADB also supplies developer shell/install/debug operations. No measured transport performance winner established by this review.
transport_answer.direct_USB: Recorded selected API36 RugKing acceptance with debugging off; still experimental, not universal or current-build acceptance. New AOA connection can reset tablet USB and interrupt an ADB route.
